lead.body: UN climate talks end with no agreement after the final text drops every mention of fossil fuels. The EU and others refuse to endorse it. The longest COP ever — and the first to fail outright since Copenhagen in 2009.
lead.headline: COP31 COLLAPSES — NO DEAL

stories.body: Cargo ship Sparta II burns in the Gulf of Finland; all 16 crew evacuated. A day later a blast wrecks the corvette Merkury in Benghazi port; 10 hurt.
stories.headline: Two Russian ships hit by drones in 24 hours

stories.body: Part of a five-storey building collapses after a Russian drone hit. Nine people evacuated; 14 remain unaccounted for under the rubble.
stories.headline: Drone strike brings down apartment block

stories.body: FBI most-wanted cartel boss Fausto Isidro Meza Flores seized in Guasave. The raid leaves 11 dead: four soldiers and seven gunmen.
stories.headline: 'El Chapo Isidro' captured

stories.body: Flames tear through a three-storey sweets factory in Cikande, west Java. Rescuers search the ruins; the missing count is still unclear.
stories.headline: Candy factory fire: 3 dead, dozens missing

stories.body: At least 258 seats after a North Carolina win by 330 votes. The largest House majority for either party in more than three decades.
stories.headline: Democrats' biggest House win since 1992

stories.body: States agree to keep negotiating lethal autonomous weapons and draft rules by 2028 — with no binding commitment.
stories.headline: 'Killer robots': talks, but no binding rules

ticker: Korea minister quits in AI exam scandal
